projects.title: wondr merchant by BNI
projects.summary: A one-stop QRIS payment app for merchants.
projects.description: wondr merchant by BNI is a one-stop solution application that makes it easier for merchants to accept QRIS payments. It is equipped with a same-day settlement schedule feature, real-time transaction notifications, and complete transaction history.

caseStudy.label: Banking
context: wondr merchant is BNI's app that helps business owners manage QRIS payments faster, more easily, and more practically.
This page only describes what BNI has published about the app. Internal implementation details are confidential.
role: Implemented features and enhancements based on business and user requirements.
Optimized application performance, usability, and reliability.
Collaborated with product, design, backend, and QA teams through the full release cycle.
Contributed to code quality, application stability, and user experience.

features.title: Faster QRIS registration
features.description: Merchants register for QRIS through a practical process so they can start accepting payments soon.

features.title: More frequent settlement
features.description: Transaction funds are settled to the merchant's account up to five times a day.

features.title: Real-time notifications
features.description: Merchants know right away when a payment comes in, without checking again and again.

features.title: Easier transaction reports
features.description: Transactions and settlements can be monitored from within the app.

projects.title: DevKit Agent
projects.summary: Multi-agent coding pipeline for OpenCode — Analyst, Planner, Programmer, Reviewer.
projects.description: Multi-agent coding pipeline for OpenCode. Install agents and skills with one command. Routes complex tasks through specialist agents — Analyst, Planner, Programmer, Reviewer — with approval checkpoints at each stage.

caseStudy.label: AI tooling
context: A single coding agent tends to jump straight into code. Complex tasks go better when requirements are clarified and a plan is agreed before anything is written.
DevKit Agent installs a team of specialist agents and skills into OpenCode with one command, and routes complex work through them with an approval checkpoint at each stage.
role: Designed the pipeline: an Orchestrator that assesses complexity and hands work to the Analyst, Planner, Programmer, and Reviewer.
Built the installer CLI with interactive, global, unattended, and uninstall modes.
Paired each agent with skills such as brainstorming, writing plans, code review, and systematic debugging.
Published the package to npm and maintain it as open source.

features.title: One-command install
features.description: npx devkit-agent installs agents and skills per project, or globally with -g.

features.title: Specialist agents
features.description: Analyst, Planner, Programmer, and Reviewer each own one stage of the work.

features.title: Approval checkpoints
features.description: Requirements and plans wait for your approval before implementation starts.

projects.title: Omaga - Ojek Mahasiswa
projects.summary: Fast and safe ride-hailing for students, to and from campus.
projects.description: A fast and safe motorcycle taxi service for students, ready to pick up and drop off to and from campus, with student rates, order history, and 24/7 support.

caseStudy.label: Mobility
context: Omaga is an online motorcycle taxi service built for students: fast and safe pick-up and drop-off to and from campus, at rates made for students.
It comes as two apps. The rider app is for ordering trips, and Omaga Driver lets students who want to take orders do so with a simple interface and a fast order system.
role: Worked on financial transactions inside the app.
Implemented real-time database streaming and real-time communication features.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams across both the rider and driver apps.

features.title: Easy ride booking
features.description: Book a ride for pick-up and drop-off to and from campus.

features.title: Order history
features.description: Check your past trips any time.

features.title: Fast order system for drivers
features.description: Omaga Driver keeps the interface simple so student drivers can take orders quickly.
